decisions.statement: A file property is filed under the key a page carries rather than under its slug.
A page claims an entry shape's file as the page claims a file property's file.
A property whose page type extends a file property is in a file as that property is.
Which properties are entry shapes is answered here rather than by the caller.
Which properties a page type holds in a file is answered under that page type alone.
Which of those properties a page type keeps outside the commit is answered the same way.
The nearer declaration decides that as the nearer declaration decides the name.
A key reaches the property its page type declares or reaches nothing.
A bare declaration name is narrowed across every kind of page property.
That narrowing is worked out once for an answer rather than once for a key.
A page type holds in a file every property every page type above that page type declares.
A declaration naming a page property no page property alone answers to declares nothing.
Which folder names a page type declares is answered as which file names are.
A question answered from one reading alone is answered once for that reading and held.
A declaration naming a file property group holds every member of that group in a file.
A member is filed under the group's slug and then the member's slug.
A member is kept outside the commit where its own declaration says so or the group's does.
The keys any page type holds in a file have each member under that same key.
A group's own key is among those keys nowhere.
A page type that is a file property group holds nothing of its own in a file.

definition: the entries a page's value implies
